claims.claim: A child on highest-rate Child Disability Payment or Disability Living Allowance care can qualify
claims.quote: the highest rate of the care component of Child Disability Payment the highest rate of the care component of Disability Living Allowance for children
claims.note: Both listed care components qualify, subject to the other scheme conditions.

claims.claim: The child must be in Scotland
claims.quote: If a child or young person gets a qualifying benefit but did not live in Scotland between 21 September and 29 September 2026, they might still qualify
claims.note: Children outside Scotland can also qualify under the stated EEA or Swiss conditions.

claims.quote: Eligible children and young people living in Scotland do not need to apply. They’ll get their payment automatically.
claims.note: Automatic payment applies to eligible children living in Scotland; eligible children abroad must apply.

claims.claim: The child must receive highest-rate Child Disability Payment care or highest-rate Disability Living Allowance for children care
claims.quote: the enhanced daily living component of Personal Independence Payment the enhanced rate of the daily living component of Adult Disability Payment
claims.note: The source gives PIP and Adult Disability Payment as additional qualifying benefits.

claims.claim: The child must be under 16, unless an extension applies
claims.quote: Children and young people in Scotland can get the assistance if they're under 19 years old
claims.note: The stated general age limit is under 19, not under 16.

claims.claim: A person aged 16 to under 19 qualifies only if still in qualifying education
claims.quote: Children and young people in Scotland can get the assistance if they're under 19 years old
claims.note: The source sets no qualifying-education condition for ages 16 to 18.

claims.claim: The child must live in Scotland
claims.quote: If the child or young person lives in an eligible European Economic Area (EEA) country or Switzerland they may be able to get Child Winter Heating Payment.
claims.note: Eligible children abroad can qualify with a sufficient link to Scotland.
